description: Source file defining the API interaction functions for the frontend of the bugflow project. It includes functions for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH), handling authentication headers, error handling, and specific API endpoints related to work items and comments.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if the provided API path is public (no authorization required) or protected.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Builds request headers, adding Authorization header for protected endpoints.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles non-OK HTTP responses, especially 401 Unauthorized, by clearing auth and redirecting to login if needed.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends an HTTP DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON response.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends an HTTP POST request with JSON body and returns parsed JSON response.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends an HTTP GET request with optional query parameters and returns parsed JSON response.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends an HTTP PATCH request with JSON body and returns parsed JSON response.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item, sourcing author_id from localStorage if not explicitly provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, using current user's displayName from localStorage for created_by.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Generates full URL for a given API path.
